sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Deal magic damage (Star) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 100 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 130.
-Target: all enemies. Amplifies Cost reducing effects by 50% for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 50 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 80 seconds for one time only.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 60. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Wicked Eclipse (decreases status ailment resistance by 50, reduces Cost recovery speed by 10, increases Ability Cost consumption by 100%, disables Unison gauge filling from Ability, Unison, and Skill effects (Unison gauge fill from taking damage or using Abilities remains unaffected)) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Flower Raft of the Blue Butterfly
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 60% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 150 seconds.
Fire and Star Defense from Unison Damage +700
